is this codebase structured well, or have we just gotten used to it?
where is the coupling in this system? every change to billing seems to end up touching payments and notifications too
do an architecture review of packages/ before we plan next quarter's work
our ADRs say the domain layer never imports from infrastructure — check whether that's still true and what else has drifted from the original design
